description_en: Invokes the CreateTrafficMirrorFilterRules operation to create inbound or outbound rules for a traffic mirror filter
description_zh: 调用CreateTrafficMirrorFilterRules接口创建流量镜像入方向或出方向规则
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-traffic-mirror-filter-rules --traffic-mirror-filter-id tmf-j6cmls82xnc86vtpe0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTrafficMirrorFilterRules

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the traffic mirror filter
parameters.help_zh: 流量镜像筛选条件的实例ID
parameters.name: traffic_mirror_filter_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.


false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, inbound or outbound rules are created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建入方向或出方向规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式和限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。


false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建入方向或出方向规则
parameters.name: dry_run

fields.help_en:
The collection policy of the inbound rule. Valid values:

accept: collects network traffic.
drop: does not collect network traffic
fields.help_zh:
入方向规则的采集策略，取值：

accept：采集网络流量。
drop：不采集网络流量
fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block of network traffic for the inbound rule
fields.help_zh: 入方向规则网络流量的目的地址网段
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en:
The destination port range of network traffic for the inbound rule. Valid values for a port: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and stop port with a forward slash (/). Format: 1/200 or 80/80.

If IngressRules.N.Protocol is set to ALL or ICMP, you do not need to configure this parameter. Settings are not required because all ports are available
fields.help_zh:
入方向规则网络流量的目的端口范围。端口范围为1~65535，使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，格式为1/200、80/80。

当IngressRules.N.Protocol取值为ALL或ICMP时，该参数无需设置，表示不限制端口
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en:
The IP version of the instance. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.
IPv6: IPv6
fields.help_zh:
实例的IP协议版本。取值：

IPv4： IPv4版本。
IPv6： IPv6版本
fields.name: ip_version

fields.help_en: The priority of the inbound rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The maximum value of N is 10, which means that you can configure up to 10 inbound rules for a traffic mirror filter
fields.help_zh: 入方向规则的优先级。数字越小，优先级越高。其中N最大取值为10，即一个筛选条件最多可配置10条入方向规则
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of network traffic to be mirrored for the inbound rule. Valid values:

ALL: all protocols.
ICMP: Internet Control Message Protocol.
TCP: Transmission Control Protocol.
UDP: User Datagram Protocol
fields.help_zh:
入方向需要镜像的网络流量使用的协议类型，取值：

ALL：所有协议。
ICMP：网络控制报文协议。
TCP：传输控制协议。
UDP：用户数据报协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block of network traffic for the inbound rule
fields.help_zh: 入方向规则网络流量的源地址网段
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en:
The source port range of network traffic for the inbound rule. Valid values for a port: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and stop port with a forward slash (/). Format: 1/200 or 80/80. A value of -1/-1 cannot be configured independently and indicates that all ports are available.

If IngressRules.N.Protocol is set to ALL or ICMP, you do not need to configure this parameter. Settings are not required because all ports are available
fields.help_zh:
入方向规则网络流量的源端口范围。端口范围为1~65535，使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，格式为1/200、80/80，其中-1/-1不能单独设置，代表不限制端口。

当IngressRules.N.Protocol取值为ALL或ICMP时，该参数无需设置，表示不限制端口
fields.name: source_port_range

parameters.help_zh: 入方向规则的详细信息

The region ID of the traffic mirror.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list. For more information about regions that support traffic mirroring, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207513.html
